boundary: This carrier tests whether scarce diagnosis, architecture persistence, and changing operating context form a non-trivial decision system. It does not establish Human enjoyment, comprehension, market demand, or G0 admission.

cycles.visibleSymptom: primary output misses target while aggregate capacity still appears viable
cycles.operatingContext: balanced contract; first architecture is still cheap to revise

cycles.visibleSymptom: priority output misses the new contract while the previous architecture remains operational
cycles.operatingContext: objective shifts toward route-sensitive delivery; yesterday's architecture is not deleted

cycles.visibleSymptom: new operating rule makes input sufficiency the dominant uncertainty while the built system persists
cycles.operatingContext: rule change raises the value of source resilience; scanning may no longer be worth its opportunity cost
